requirements.title: Responsible-Use Deployment Gate
requirements.description: Editing real people is gated at DEPLOYMENT, not at the capability. Public/monetized deployment requires: NSFW/CSAM auto-scan on by default, C2PA provenance on by default (at least for real-person edits), a published Acceptable-Use Policy, a consent affirmation + logging on identity-altering ops, and abuse rate-limiting. Local/personal use is unrestricted; the hard non-goals (no recognition / face-swap / deepfake) remain enforced. Naturalize is low-weight; body/clothing/pose edits are high-weight. Built in api/internal/safety (tier resolution + policy + op-weight table + consent log + rate limiter) and enforced on the AI submit edge (handlers/ai); discovery via SafetyService.GetPolicy.

validation.notes: Policy/tier/op-weight/consent-log/rate-limiter logic: local unrestricted; public blocks high-weight ops without consent, forces NSFW scan, records affirmed consent.
Submit-edge enforcement: public tier returns 403 for an identity-altering op without consent_affirmed; never blocks none-weight ops or the local tier.
SafetyService.GetPolicy reports the resolved policy + op-weight table for local and public tiers.
